request: 为 Aide Computer Bridge 原生 macOS 应用添加 Aide 图标，构建时自动生成并写入 app bundle，并验证图标资源。
initial_status: Clean main worktree at c4830423e4929b05c3e929b308d83400928a8fe2; task record was the only new file.
acceptance: Native Aide Computer Bridge .app contains a valid AppIcon.icns and declares it in Info.plist.
Generated icon follows the existing Aide favicon blue square and white lowercase a mark.
Bridge bundle identifier and executable identity remain unchanged.

requirements.summary: User requested an Aide icon for the native Computer Bridge; scope is the macOS app bundle icon only.
evidence: Existing favicon at internal/server/web/favicon.svg is the approved visual source.

design.summary: Generate a standard .icns resource from the existing blue-and-white Aide mark during bridge app packaging and declare CFBundleIconFile.
evidence: Keep local.aide.computer-bridge identifier, executable, configuration path, and OS permission behavior unchanged.

implementation.summary: Added a CoreGraphics/CoreText icon renderer and wired build-native-computer-bridge.sh to generate a multi-resolution ICNS app resource and declare it in the bundle plist.
evidence: scripts/render-computer-bridge-icon.swift creates standard 16–1024 px PNG variants in the Aide favicon style.
scripts/build-native-computer-bridge.sh embeds the ICNS resource and retains local.aide.computer-bridge.

verification.summary: Built a temporary app bundle and installed the same build to the configured user Application Support location. Validated icon round-trip, bundle metadata, and code signature.
evidence: iconutil decoded the embedded ICNS back into PNG sizes; visual inspection showed the blue rounded square and white Aide a.
Installed bundle Info.plist reports CFBundleIconFile AppIcon and CFBundleIdentifier local.aide.computer-bridge; codesign --verify --deep --strict: PASS.
git diff --check: PASS. No full product test suite was needed for this resource-only packaging change.

documentation.summary: Updated the computer/browser control guide with icon generation, bundle declaration, and permission-identity behavior.
evidence: docs/plugins/computer-browser-control.md describes the packaged Aide icon and unchanged bundle identity.

cleanup.summary: Build trap removed generated iconset and renderer scratch files; only scoped source, docs, and task record are uncommitted.
evidence: git status --short lists only the two scoped source/doc edits, renderer source, and task record.

release.summary: This request installs the updated local bridge app but did not request a Git push or product release.
evidence: Installed app bundle signature and icon metadata were verified locally.

rollback: Rebuild from the preceding source revision with scripts/build-native-computer-bridge.sh; the bundle identifier was preserved. No configuration or permission data was changed.
handoff: The on-disk bridge app has the new icon. If its Dock icon is stale while the app is already running, quit and reopen Aide Computer Bridge to refresh the displayed icon.
